page.layout: One manuscript page: a handwritten German letter in Kurrent script, filling the upper two-thirds. Below it, a handwritten signature block and a typed archive note at the lower left.
page.notes: No printed text on this scan. The page is a handwritten letter (German, Kurrent script), which falls outside this transcription task, so it is left out. The letter opens with "...die gnad Gottes sey mit uns allen, Amen. Ehrenvester, fromer, fürsichtiger..." and is dated "Zürich den ersten Novembers ... Jar" with the year partly unclear. The signature reads roughly "Ludwig Walser" (uncertain). Typed archive annotation at lower left, "Orig. versetzt: Ms. Briefe fol." with the date "17.10.70", is a library mark and is left out. Show-through from the reverse is present in the lower part of the page and is left out. If you want the handwritten letter transcribed, that would need a different format from this printed-book template.
